meta.name: add-dial
meta.description: Add Dial channel integration — a real phone number for SMS and AI voice calls via the Dial platform (getdial.ai). Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给应用接入真实号码,支持短信与AI语音通话
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在开发需要电话或短信能力的应用
copy.tagline_en: Add a real phone number for SMS and AI voice calls to your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app that needs phone or SMS capabilities

howto.what: 为 NanoClaw 添加 Dial 电话号码:复制并注册适配器、安装依赖并测试;引导登录 Dial、确认号码、设置来电问候语与默认发送方;配对手机后即可用该号码收发短信和 AI 语音电话。
howto.when: 当用户要求添加 Dial 电话号码、开通短信/语音通话,或使用 /add-dial-tool 命令时触发。随后进入登录、确认号码、设置接入权限和配对手机的流程。

say.text: 帮我添加 Dial 电话号码
say.note: 开始接入 Dial 通道的完整设置流程

say.text: 把 Dial 号码设为默认发送方
say.note: 会确认号码并写入配置

say.text: 开始配对手机,开通 Dial 来电
say.note: 进入 6 位配对码流程

howto.what_en: Adds a Dial number to NanoClaw: copies/registers the adapter, installs deps, runs tests; guides Dial sign-in, number confirmation, greeting, default sender; after pairing, the number handles SMS and AI voice calls.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to add a Dial phone number, enable SMS/voice, or runs /add-dial-tool; then walks through sign-in, number confirmation, access policy, and phone pairing.

say_en.text: Add a Dial phone number for me
say_en.note: Starts the full Dial channel setup flow

say_en.text: Set the Dial number as the default sender
say_en.note: Confirms the number and writes config

say_en.text: Start phone pairing for Dial calls
